# Open in AI Agent for Gmail

> Free, MIT-licensed, 100% local browser extension (`v1.6.0`) that lets Gmail users hand individual threads, multiple selected threads, or unread inbox batches directly to the AI subscriptions and local coding/operations agents they already use, with zero middleman servers, zero Google OAuth token handoff to third parties, and built-in prompt-injection defanging.

## Core capabilities

- **Supported web AIs:** Claude (`claude.ai`), ChatGPT (`chatgpt.com`), Gemini (`gemini.google.com`), Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Grok, Le Chat (Mistral), DeepSeek, plus plain clipboard copy for any AI.
- **Supported desktop and CLI agents:** Claude Code (`Claude.app` or `claude` CLI), OpenAI Codex (`ChatGPT.app` or `codex` CLI), Google Antigravity (`agy` CLI or `Gemini.app`), and Google Gemini CLI (`gemini`), via OS deep links or an optional local Native Messaging companion (`com.openinaiagent.host`).
- **Multi-thread handling:** Open 2 to 5 selected Gmail threads as separate sessions, each automatically named after its email subject, or combine up to 25 threads into a single task-sorted batch.
- **Unread inbox triage:** One-click `Triage unread` button inside Gmail's toolbar reads up to 25 unread threads from Gmail's print view without opening them or marking them as read, sorting them into Action, Consolidate, Disregard, and Draft.
- **Security and privacy model:** Runs strictly client-side in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Vivaldi, Opera, and Firefox (`140+`). Strips invisible Unicode tag/control characters (`ASCII smuggling`) and defangs fake delimiter markers inside untrusted email bodies before building prompts.
